name: mini-browser-app-ui
description: Component-mode frontend for aw-app-mini-browser — owns ONLY the window's title-bar pop-out action (core.window.titlebar:mini-browser.main). The window BODY stays a plain declarative iframe (windows/main.json -> /view, server-rendered by viewer.py) — no app JS in the SPA for the body, same as before this contribution existed. src/plugin.jsx is the integrated-mode entry (register(host)), built as a Vite lib-mode bundle consumed by aw-app.json's contributes.frontend.bundle.
